title: Gemini in Chrome can read the page you're on
description:
Gemini in Chrome can read the page you are looking at. On a computer, click Ask Gemini at the top of Chrome. First time, you opt in. After that it uses the current tab. Type @ to add up to ten other open tabs. Not in Incognito. Work accounts need an admin.

Source: https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/16283624
